#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_host=10.100.108.10
destination=/etc/inventory/app.conf
temporary=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
ssh -T -i /root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519 \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_known_hosts \
  root@"$source_host" >"$temporary"
chown root:root "$temporary"
chmod 0644 "$temporary"
mv -f "$temporary" "$destination"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
